name: DOOM (2016)
notes: VERIFIED 12 Sep 2026, Apple M4, macOS 26.5.1. id Tech 6 Vulkan (winevulkan → fly-mvkshim → MoltenVK 1.4.1 → Metal). No D3D layer is involved; translationLayer dxvk + dxvk false is the MoltenVK Steam launch path. Three conditions, all measured: (1) fly-mvkshim in the launching tree's Wine/lib, or vkCreateDevice fails VK_ERROR_FEATURE_NOT_PRESENT on the 15th and 39th VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures flags (depthBounds, shaderCullDistance). Wyn ships that shim as source: Tools/fly_mvkshim.c, built by scripts/build-mvkshim.sh, installed into the launching tree by WynWineInstaller.ensureVulkanFeatureShim (keyed on ProfileValidator.isVulkanNative, which this profile satisfies via WINEDLLOVERRIDES vulkan-1). The run measured here used a recovered Aug 2026 binary with no source (135,200 bytes, md5 e8e03ea1b3976f1db16580f5dc3e0bcd); the rewrite is verified to the same contract by Tools/fly_mvkshim_probe.c — stock MoltenVK 1.4.1 gives VK_ERROR_FEATURE_NOT_PRESENT, the shim gives VK_SUCCESS on Apple M4 — but the in-game run above predates it. (2) Launch THROUGH STEAM — wyn play doom-2016, no --direct. A hand-launched process has no COM apartment, XAudio2 2.7 is COM-only, and the game renders then sits at 91% forever with no ErrorLog (401 'apartment not initialised' in 45 s vs 1 via steam.exe -applaunch). Steam's GameOverlayRenderer64/steamclient create the MTA. (3) Copy DOOMx64vk.exe over DOOMx64.exe (keep the original as DOOMx64.exe.wyn-bak, 77,431,808 bytes) because -applaunch runs Steam's default option: the OpenGL build, a dead end at Apple's GL 4.1 (ERROR_INVALID_VERSION_ARB). Steam verify integrity reverts the copy. Played: DOOMConfig.local at 00:06 with r_renderAPI 1 (Vulkan), profile.bin at 00:08. No ErrorLog on that run (earlier ErrorLogs were XAudio2 FATAL from --direct). Quit wrote CrashHandler ACCESS_VIOLATION in ntdll with no source address — Wine teardown, not the 91% hang. Two fragment pipelines fail to compile (in_TexCoord1 missing); did not stop play. Do not chase Denuvo BCryptDuplicateHash fixmes or Razer Chroma lines. Do not use Libraries.rgl.
